about: Cherrim keeps its Sunshine Form only while it has Flower Gift: one that loses the ability or has it suppressed goes back to its Overcast Form, in the sun too (Pokemon Central, Regalfiore). A level-10 Pikachu is given Sunny Day and Gastro Acid in the running battle (teach:) against a forced wild Cherrim that knows only Splash: Sunny Day brings its Sunshine Form (battler1.form 1, CHERRIM_SUNNY), and Gastro Acid, with the sun still out, its Overcast Form back (0, CHERRIM_CLOUDY; the species is SPECIES_CHERRIM in both). Before, the form change asked the species alone, so the suppressed Cherrim stayed in its Sunshine Form. The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.
